summary: Iteration 4 testing complete - 12/12 backend tests passed, all frontend features verified. Dynamic pricing from admin settings, Stripe removal, Terms page, PayPal-only checkout all working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 4 features verified: (1) Dynamic pricing: GET /api/plans returns admin-configured prices with defaults pro_monthly=5.49, studio_monthly=14.29, yearly_discount=25%. Yearly prices auto-calculated. (2) Admin settings: GET /api/admin/settings returns defaults object with pricing keys. PUT /api/admin/settings/draft accepts pricing keys with validation (prices clamped 0.99-999, discount clamped 0-80). POST /api/admin/apply merges draft INTO applied (preserves existing keys). (3) Stripe removed: POST /api/payments/checkout returns 404, POST /api/webhook/stripe returns 404. (4) PayPal still works: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} works, POST /api/payments/paypal/create-order uses dynamic pricing. (5) Terms page: New /terms route with 3 sections (terms-section, refund-section, privacy-snapshot) and contact block (terms-contact) linking to neural.melodies.notes@gmail.com. (6) Landing footer: 'Terms & Refunds' link (footer-terms-link) navigates to /terms. (7) Pricing page: No Stripe CTA buttons, 'CHECKOUT WITH' label above PayPal buttons, footer mentions PayPal only + links to Terms. (8) Admin page: New PRICING section (admin-pricing-section) with price inputs (admin-pro-price-input, admin-studio-price-input) and yearly discount slider (admin-yearly-discount-slider, admin-yearly-discount-value). Full flow tested: admin changes price → saves draft → applies → Pricing page reflects new price → PayPal create-order uses new amount.
